pages.text: Build the Wither using the required blocks and three Wither Skeleton Skulls. The player placing the final skull records the encounter for their team.$(br2)That player or a member of the same recorded team must defeat the same Wither. The same membership and kill-credit rules apply as for the Warden.
Choose a battlefield away from valuable builds. Prepare your equipment, supplies and route back before placing the final skull.
